cards.title: for loops
cards.body: A `for` loop has three parts: where to start, when to keep going, and how to step.

cards.title: Other steps
cards.body: Change the step to count by 2, or count down with `i--` or `i -= 2`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: It starts at 0 and stops before 3, because the condition is `i < 3`.

exercise.prompt: Read N and print the numbers from 1 to N, one per line. Use a `for` loop.
exercise.starterCode:
const n = Number(prompt());
// print 1 to n, one per line
